description: SDK calls that do not match the MCP tool registry, one entry per SDK call site. A ratchet: it records existing divergence, it does not approve it. Shrink with scripts/check-sdk-contract-alignment.py --update-baseline; adding entries needs --allow-new-drift --reason.
